question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    -- Calculate age exactly 25 years at the time of the order
    -- Age is 25 if the 25th anniversary of birth_date is on or before the order date,
    -- and the 26th anniversary is after the order date.
    -- Using SQLite date functions: birth_date + 25 years <= order_date < birth_date + 26 years
    (c.birth_date || ' 00:00:00') <= (o.date) AND
    (o.date) < (c.birth_date || ' 00:00:00') + (26 * 365 + 6) * 86400  -- Approximate 26 years
    -- More precise: use strftime to add years
    AND 
    (strftime('%Y-%m-%d', o.date) >= strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+25 years') AND
     strftime('%Y-%m-%d', o.date) < strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date, '+26 years'))
